label: Fatigue life, Paris law
text: EN.O.A1.3.6 Fatigue life. Basquin (stress-life) and Coffin–Manson (strain-life) relations, fitted per material. Paris law da/dN = C (ΔK)^m holds in region II only; C and m depend on material and R-ratio (Paris and Erdogan 1963).

warrant.standard: Prediction matches test within stated uncertainty; code calibration meets the target reliability index
warrant.defeaters: Hypothesis outside range (slenderness, small strain, linearity); imperfection sensitivity; residual stress; unmodelled failure mode
